title: Guardians of the Galaxy
description: Marvel’s Guardians of the GalaxyPeter Quill is Star-Lord, the brash adventurer who, to save the universe from its greatest threats, joins forces with a quartet of disparate misfits — fan-favorite Rocket Raccoon, a tree-like humanoid named Groot, the enigmatic, expert fighter Gamora and the rough edged warrior Drax the Destroyer.Please Note That Season 3 is not available in Tamil and Telugu.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x1
episodes_data.description: The newly-christened Guardians of the Galaxy come into possession of a dangerous artifact that has Thanos’ new lieutenant, Korath, after them.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x2
episodes_data.description: The Guardians struggle to subdue the suddenly-sprung-to-life Celestial head that is the Knowhere space colony, as well as storm Korath’s ship to rescue Quill, Gamora and the mysterious CryptoCube that holds the Cosmic Seed.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x3
episodes_data.description: Feeling underappreciated, Rocket accepts an offer to work for The Collector, only to realize his “job” is working as another prisoner in The Collector’s collection.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x4
episodes_data.description: The Guardians crash land on a space station run by the Grandmaster, who schemes to get Drax back in the gladiatorial arena to battle his ultimate opponent: Gamora.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x5
episodes_data.description: When Groot is infected by a parasitic fungus, the Guardians must embark on a perilous journey in order to save him.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x6
episodes_data.description: Caught red-handed by Titus, the Guardians are coerced into infiltrating a notorious gang of weapons dealers known as the Black Order.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x7
episodes_data.description: Quill gets mixed up in a game of deceit when Gamora tries to pit her siblings, Nebula and Korath, against each other.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x8
episodes_data.description: Peter Quill is Star-Lord, the brash adventurer who, to save the universe from its greatest threats, joins forces with a quartet of disparate misfits â€” fan-favorite Rocket Raccoon, a tree-like humanoid named Groot, the enigmatic, expert fighter Gamora and the rough edged warrior Drax the Destroyer.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x9
episodes_data.description: Rocket is abducted and taken back to his home planet, Half World.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x10
episodes_data.description: The Guardians encounter a living planet that's fallen under the control of a revived Ronan.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x11
episodes_data.description: The Guardians get caught up in a rivalry between The Collector and The Grandmaster.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x12
episodes_data.description: The Guardians must help save the City of Attilan from Ronan.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x13
episodes_data.description: The Guardians find the Asgardian Destroyer Armor that leads to an epic battle pitting the Detroyer Armor against Drax the Destroyer.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x14
episodes_data.description: Quill goes missing while following the Cryptocube's readings.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x15
episodes_data.description: The Guardians must stop Ronan's plan to blow up the Kree Supreme Intelligence.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x16
episodes_data.description: In search of the Cosmic Seed, the Guardians unexpectedly find themselves in Asgard where they must outwit Thor and Angela in order to discover the seed's origins.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x17
episodes_data.description: Following a falling out with his father, Star-Lord finds a ship containing the A.I. Rora as he takes it off of Spartax with the Drax the Destroyer and Groot providing a diversion for the Spartax Royal Guards. Afterwards, the Guardians of the Galaxy have to deal with Lucy and Supergiant who are jilted that Star-Lord is the Prince of Sparta.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x18
episodes_data.description: When Asgard attacks Spartax, Quill and the Guardians become caught in the middle trying to expose the deception behind the conflict.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x19
episodes_data.description: The Guardians and Asgardians team up to rescue Quill from Thanos.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x20
episodes_data.description: Gamora attempts to make amends for her past misdeeds only to find herself in a deadly trap set by Nebula, Ronan and the Grandmaster.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x21
episodes_data.description: The Guardians pay the Inhumans a visit to learn more about the Cosmic Seed.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x22
episodes_data.description: The Guardians discover that the Cosmic Seed is back on Earth. In the company of Cosmo, Star-Lord returns to his hometown where he runs into his childhood bully Michael Coogan who is now the sheriff. Now Star-Lord and the Guardians of the Galaxy must find the Cosmic Seed before Korath the Pursuer does.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x23
episodes_data.description: When the Guardians of the Galaxy's search for the Cosmic Seed continues on Earth, Star-Lord contacts Gorgon where he gets the location of the former site of Attilan. While checking out the area, Rocket Raccoon, Groot, and Drax the Destroyer have visions of the Cosmic Seed energy helping them out like Rocket Raccoon's family being re-evolved, Groot being able to restore the Flora colossi, and Drax the Destroyer being able to see his family again. Even after fighting their way past the Cosmic Seed-enhanced worms and spiders, the Guardians of the Galaxy must keep Ronan the Accuser and Nebula from getting the box containing the Cosmic Seed.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x24
episodes_data.description: Now that Thanos has the Cosmic Seed, he takes control of the Earth and molds it into his personal planetary weapon of mass destruction. The Guardians of the Galaxy must work to reclaim the Cosmic Seed from Thanos even when Ronan the Accuser and Nebula plan to dispose of Thanos with plans of having the Earth be destroyed alongside him.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x25
episodes_data.description: The Guardians discover that Yondu has been impersonating them in order to con unsuspecting victims.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 1x26
episodes_data.description: The team stages a Christmas Carol inspired con-job in order to frighten a despot out of his ill-gotten riches and free his enslaved people.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x1
episodes_data.description: While trying to dispose of Thanos' asteroid, the Guardians discover it has been taken to a secure facility that belongs to the Avengers.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x2
episodes_data.description: The Guardians and the Avengers team up to find out what powerful secrets lie inside Thanos' asteroid.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x3
episodes_data.description: When Rocket and Drax wake up with absolutely no memory of the night before, the Guardians must piece together their adventures.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x4
episodes_data.description: While the Guardians search for the missing sarcophagus, Groot finds a mysterious egg and does everything in his power to protect it.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x5
episodes_data.description: When the Guardians are charged with escorting the young and rebellious Rigellian Princess Tana back home, Drax's hardened heart melts as he is reminded of his own daughter.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x6
episodes_data.description: After being infused with incredible power from a Nova Helmet, Gamora leads the Guardians and her sister Nebula on a mission to infiltrate the Believer flagship.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x7
episodes_data.description: Quill and Gamora battle the High Evolutionary, his minion hybrids and a teleport-hijacking Nebula.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x8
episodes_data.description: Cosmo goes undercover on the Believer Flagship but loses his powers when his cover is blown.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x9
episodes_data.description: When the Believer Flagship embeds itself in Knowhere's brain, it causes a planetoid-wide telekinetic zombie outbreak.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x10
episodes_data.description: When the cocoon opens and reveals a baby warlock inside, the Guardians have to step in to be a positive guiding force to keep his powers in check.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x11
episodes_data.description: The Guardians discover Groot's homeworld, Planet X, has been overrun by Symbiotes who will stop at nothing to get Groot's restarted World Pod for themselves to conquer the galaxy.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x12
episodes_data.description: As a comet covered in Symbiotes hurls toward Spartax, the Guardians must team up with Quill's sister to save the planet.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x13
episodes_data.description: When the Symbiotes escape to Asgard and venomize Thor, Odin and the other Asgardians, it is up to the Guardians to save them, the World Tree and all of existence.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x14
episodes_data.description: The Guardians meet Sam Alexander, an Earth teen experimenting with his father’s Nova helmet, but the Guardians aren’t the only ones who know of the helmet’s power.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x15
episodes_data.description: The Guardians chase after J’son and Mantis as they try to manipulate Sam to do their bidding by promising him clues to the location of his missing father.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x16
episodes_data.description: When the Nova Corps catch up with the Guardians and Sam, the fight reaches Sam’s hometown.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x17
episodes_data.description: Searching for a weapon strong enough to match J’son, the Guardians seek out master boom-maker Ja Kyee.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x18
episodes_data.description: When the guardians travel to Drax's home planet in hopes of summoning Warlock, they discover Xeron seeks to destroy Adam and Drax's homecoming, which becomes a fight to protect his friends.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x19
episodes_data.description: Rocket and Warlock travel to Halfworld to try and re-evolve Rocket's family.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x20
episodes_data.description: Gamora trains Warlock to be a strong and powerful warrior like herself. But when Gamora’s lessons become too intense, Warlock clams up and gets kidnapped by the Collector.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x21
episodes_data.description: When Quill and Warlock are hunted by J'son and the Black Order, Quill teaches Warlock the importance of never letting himself slip into the path of evil.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x22
episodes_data.description: During the Xandrian Feast of the Three Grinning Moons, the Guardians must pull a reverse heist by planting a dangerous weapon inside a Nova Corps vault.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x23
episodes_data.description: Warlock has gone dark! By absorbing J’son into his gem, Warlock has become Dark Warlock (Magus) with his sights set on conquering the galaxy, starting with Spartax.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x24
episodes_data.description: The Guardians and Nova battle Dark Warlock (Magus) and J’son on Planet Y. Can our heroes save their friend Warlock and the universe before it’s too late?

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 2x25
episodes_data.description: In order to save the Guardians from the ruthless asteroid Korvac, Quill must bust J'Son out of prison on Spartax and in the process he sees a new side of his father.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x1
episodes_data.description: The Guardians must work together to escape the elaborate prisons created for them by The Collector.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x2
episodes_data.description: The Guardians meet up with Spider-Man in New York City to defeat Thanos’ super-powered symbiote.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x3
episodes_data.description: The Guardians team up with Spider-Man to battle Thanos, who has harnessed the power of the Carnage Symbiote to become the ultimate weapon.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x4
episodes_data.description: The Guardians have captured Thanos, but it's no easy task transporting the most wanted criminal in the galaxy.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x5
episodes_data.description: The Guardians chase Thanos and Sam Alexander (Nova) to Thanos’ home planet of Titan, where they discover a gladiatorial arena featuring Jesse Alexander - Nova’s father!

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x6
episodes_data.description: The Guardians now have everything they ever dreamed of, but money can’t solve their problems.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x7
episodes_data.description: Gamora decides to use her new riches to repay all of the people she has wronged throughout the years. When Nebula shows up, Gamora tries to teach her the value of doing good.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x8
episodes_data.description: Drax decides he no longer wants to be a Destroyer and looks into new occupations.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x9
episodes_data.description: Quill starts his own talk show after beating Thanos! But to his dismay, everyone seems to hate it, especially the Grandmaster who is rigging the segments to destroy Quill.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x10
episodes_data.description: The Guardians squander their riches and take on a simple transport job. It turns out that they are stealing from the Kree, and Phyla the Accuser will do anything to get it back!

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x11
episodes_data.description: The Guardians find themselves in prison for stealing a mysterious package from the Kree - but it was all a set up by Howard the Duck.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x12
episodes_data.description: The Guardians track down Howard the Duck to find out who set them up and why, but they don’t get far before Phyla the Accuser catches up to them to deliver some Kree justice.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x13
episodes_data.description: Phyla-Vell reluctantly teams up with the Guardians to bring The Collector to justice for destroying her home planet.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x14
episodes_data.description: When the Guardians become separated in the Black Vortex, Gamora wakes up in a children’s fairy tale, while Drax is trapped in a comic book.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x15
episodes_data.description: While caught in a CG sinister packing factory, Rocket must search for his best friend Groot and escape.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x16
episodes_data.description: Quill finds himself in a claymation world where the Milano is flying into the sun, threatening to melt him. Meanwhile, Groot and Drax must fight Ronan in a Golden Age world.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x17
episodes_data.description: Gamora and Quill battle their way through an 8-bit Super Marvel World.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x18
episodes_data.description: The Guardians finally make it out of the Black Vortex, only to find that the galaxy has been taken over by sinister robots called the Darkhawks, who are disguised as their friends.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x19
episodes_data.description: The Guardians don’t know who to trust as the Darkhawks seem to have duplicated everyone, including Quill.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x20
episodes_data.description: The Guardians finally make it out of the Black Vortex, only to find that the galaxy has been taken over by sinister robots called the Darkhawks, who are disguised as their friends.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x21
episodes_data.description: The Guardians don't know who to trust as the Darkhawks seem to have duplicated everyone, including Quill.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x22
episodes_data.description: The Guardians have to team up with Loki in Asgard when The Serpent infects the World Tree and threatens to destroy the universe.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x23
episodes_data.description: As the Guardians prepare to take the fight to The Serpent, they Bifrost around the galaxy to gather reinforcements.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x24
episodes_data.description: The Guardians and their friends search for the fragments of Dragonfang, a legendary weapon that will finally be able to defeat The Serpent forever.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x25
episodes_data.description: The Guardians, Loki and Iron Man travel to the castle of the evil Hela to ask her help in fighting The Serpent.

episodes_data.title: Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy 3x26
episodes_data.description: With the Nova Corps defeated and the fate of the entire universe in jeopardy, the Guardians must turn to an unlikely ally to stop The Serpent.
